The completeness certificate was gated on gen.name === 'enum' rather than on the four conditions it actually rests on. A generator that exhausted its declared box, audited every reject, and produced no REFUSED and no schema-invalid candidate earned the certificate and was refused it for having a different name. Removing the name test leaves the four real conditions untouched — this deletes a refusal, it does not add a check.
